-- Creating External data sources

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.external_data_sources
    WHERE name = 'SILVER_DATA_SOURCE'
)
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE SILVER_DATA_SOURCE 
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://silver@bankingproject4storage.dfs.core.windows.net/'
);

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT *
    FROM sys.external_data_sources
    WHERE name = 'GOLD_DATA_SOURCE'
)
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE GOLD_DATA_SOURCE
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://gold@bankingproject4storage.dfs.core.windows.net/'
);


-- Create External Table for Customer Segmentation
IF EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables st 
    JOIN  sys.external_data_sources sd 
    ON st.data_source_id = sd.data_source_id AND st.name = 'gold_customer_segmentation' and sd.name = 'GOLD_DATA_SOURCE')
BEGIN
DROP EXTERNAL TABLE  dbo.gold_customer_segmentation
END;
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.gold_customer_segmentation
(
    id BIGINT,
    current_age INT,
    gender VARCHAR(20),
    yearly_income FLOAT,
    total_debt FLOAT,
    credit_score INT,
    debt_to_income_ratio FLOAT,
    age_band VARCHAR(20),
    customer_segment VARCHAR(30)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'customer_segmentation/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GOLD_DATA_SOURCE,
    FILE_FORMAT = MyParquetFormat
);


IF EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables st 
    JOIN  sys.external_data_sources sd 
    ON st.data_source_id = sd.data_source_id AND st.name = 'gold_spending_transactions' and sd.name = 'GOLD_DATA_SOURCE')
BEGIN
DROP EXTERNAL TABLE gold_spending_transactions
END;
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.gold_spending_transactions
(
    transaction_id BIGINT,
    client_id BIGINT,
    card_id BIGINT,
    transaction_timestamp DATETIME2,
    transaction_date DATE,
    amount FLOAT,
    transaction_amount FLOAT,
    use_chip VARCHAR(100),
    merchant_city VARCHAR(100),
    merchant_state VARCHAR(100),
    mcc INT,
    category VARCHAR(200)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'spending_transactions/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GOLD_DATA_SOURCE,
    FILE_FORMAT = MyParquetFormat
);

-- Create External Table for Credit Utilization

IF EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables st 
    JOIN  sys.external_data_sources sd 
    ON st.data_source_id = sd.data_source_id AND st.name = 'gold_credit_utilization' and sd.name = 'GOLD_DATA_SOURCE')
BEGIN
DROP EXTERNAL TABLE gold_credit_utilization
END;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.gold_credit_utilization
(
    customer_id BIGINT,
    current_age INT,
    gender VARCHAR(20),
    yearly_income FLOAT,
    total_debt FLOAT,
    credit_score INT,
    total_credit_limit FLOAT,
    total_cards INT,
    credit_utilization FLOAT,
    utilization_band VARCHAR(30)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'credit_utilization/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GOLD_DATA_SOURCE,
    FILE_FORMAT = MyParquetFormat
);

-- Create External Table for Fraud Monitoring
IF EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables st 
    JOIN  sys.external_data_sources sd 
    ON st.data_source_id = sd.data_source_id AND st.name = 'gold_fraud_monitoring' and sd.name = 'GOLD_DATA_SOURCE')
BEGIN
DROP EXTERNAL TABLE gold_fraud_monitoring
END;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.gold_fraud_monitoring
(
    transaction_id BIGINT,
    client_id BIGINT,
    card_id BIGINT,
    transaction_timestamp DATETIME2,
    transaction_date DATE,
    amount FLOAT,
    transaction_amount FLOAT,
    use_chip VARCHAR(100),
    merchant_city VARCHAR(100),
    merchant_state VARCHAR(100),
    mcc INT,
    category VARCHAR(200),
    fraud_label VARCHAR(10),
    is_fraud INT
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'fraud_monitoring/',
    DATA_SOURCE = GOLD_DATA_SOURCE,
    FILE_FORMAT = MyParquetFormat
);


-- Create Views
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_customer_segmentation','V') IS NULL
BEGIN
EXEC
('CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_customer_segmentation
AS
SELECT
    id AS customer_id,
    current_age,
    gender,
    yearly_income,
    total_debt,
    credit_score,
    debt_to_income_ratio,
    age_band,
    customer_segment
FROM dbo.gold_customer_segmentation;
')
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_spending_transactions', 'V') IS NULL
BEGIN
EXEC ('CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_spending_transactions
AS
SELECT
    transaction_id,
    client_id,
    card_id,
    transaction_timestamp,
    transaction_date,
    amount,
    transaction_amount,
    use_chip,
    merchant_city,
    merchant_state,
    mcc,
    category
FROM dbo.gold_spending_transactions;
'
)
END;


IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_credit_utilization', 'V') IS NULL
BEGIN
EXEC ('CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_credit_utilization
AS
SELECT
    customer_id,
    current_age,
    gender,
    yearly_income,
    total_debt,
    credit_score,
    total_credit_limit,
    total_cards,
    credit_utilization,
    utilization_band
FROM dbo.gold_credit_utilization;
'
)
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_fraud_monitoring', 'V') IS NULL
BEGIN
EXEC ('CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_fraud_monitoring
AS
SELECT
    transaction_id,
    client_id,
    card_id,
    transaction_timestamp,
    transaction_date,
    amount,
    transaction_amount,
    use_chip,
    merchant_city,
    merchant_state,
    mcc,
    category,
    fraud_label,
    is_fraud
FROM dbo.gold_fraud_monitoring;'
)
END;


select * from dbo.vw_fraud_monitoring
